patch.summary: Is HyNote worth it? HyNote is an AI note taker that turns meetings, audio, PDFs, YouTube, images (OCR), web pages, and phone calls into searchable notes with summaries, action items, and 30+ templates — without a meeting bot. Free includes recording/transcription (120 min/session…. Strong when Individuals and students who need multimodal notes (meetings + PDFs + YouTube) without a bot. Weak when No meeting bot auto-join — capture is device recording or file upload (polarising vs Fireflies bot UX).

scenarios.body: Individuals and students who need multimodal notes (meetings + PDFs + YouTube) without a bot; Buyers who want a free forever floor and a sub-list price annual Pro entry; Teams that prefer device recording / upload over auto-join bots

sections.body:

Avoid if: Compare Fireflies.ai for auto-join bots and Business conversation intelligence; Otter.ai for a mature meeting-notes peer; Microsoft 365 Copilot if Teams recap is already in the tenant..
